title: Single-nuclei suspensions from primary human esophagus tissue
author: Lucy Kimbley
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.t9wer7e

steps.title: Prepare Dounce homogenizer
steps.instruction: Pre-chill a Dounce homogenizer with pestle B containing 2 ml of ice-cold Nuclei EZ lysis buffer.

steps.title: Prepare tissue sample
steps.instruction: Remove tissue from storage (-20°C in RNALater-ICE) and hold in a petri dish on wet ice.

substeps.instruction: If not utilizing all frozen tissue, sever off the required amount using a cold scalpel and return the remainder to storage.

steps.title: Tissue homogenization
steps.instruction: Cut tissue into very small pieces using a cold scalpel and transfer to the Dounce homogenizer.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the homogenizer is not overloaded (~30 mg per Dounce at one time).
Homogenize for 30 strokes with pestle B (pre-chilled in ice-cold Nuclei EZ lysis buffer) on ice, occasionally removing from ice to check that tissue is reduced to ~90% homogenous small particles.

steps.title: Transfer and initial incubation
steps.instruction: Transfer homogenate to a 15 mL conical centrifuge tube on ice using a 1 mL pipet.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the Dounce homogenizer with an additional 1 mL of ice-cold Nuclei EZ lysis buffer.
Avoid transferring large particulates of unhomogenized tissue to prevent RNase activation.

steps.title: First filtration and centrifugation
steps.instruction: Filter the suspension through a 40 μM cell strainer into a 50 ml conical centrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the nuclei/tissue suspension at 700 x g at 4°C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Second wash and incubation
steps.instruction: Re-suspend isolated nuclei in 4 ml of ice-cold Nuclei EZ lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge nuclei suspension at 500 x g at 4°C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Third wash and filtration
steps.instruction: Re-suspend nuclei in 3 mL NSB and filter through a 30 μM strainer into a 50 mL conical centrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge nuclei suspension at 500 x g at 4°C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Final suspension
steps.instruction: Re-suspend nuclei in 1-2 mL NSB and hold on wet ice (4°C).

steps.title: Nuclei counting
steps.instruction: Dilute 10 μL of nuclei suspension 1 in 10 with NSB into a micro-centrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Perform a 1:2 dilution by adding 10 μl of nuclei suspension to either 10 μl Trypan blue or 10 μl DAPI stain (300 nM in PBS).
If using DAPI, incubate for 2 minutes before counting.
Count nuclei using an Improved Neubauer haemocytometer.
